text: Duplicate/redundant exported functions — Three generations count functions exported (record_counts, calculate_record_counts, calculate_phase_count, calculate_initial_records, calculate_detailed_records, calculate_phase_records). Gen 2 used app. Gen 1 old table wrappers (record_counts_table, record_summary_table) deprecated removed. Keeping three confuses API users. count_unique() — NA handling (compare.R:21): Doesn’t explicitly handle NAs. filter(!.na(cite_source) & cite_source != ""). calculate_detailed_records() hardcodes cite_label == "search" (new_count_and_table.R:205): user labels initial results anything exactly "search", returns 0 unique records. silent failure — warning. dedup.R — journal may get filled database name: coalesce journal = coalesce(journal, source) runs source overwritten cite_source. records journal missing source (RIS “” field, DBs set database name rather journal) present, journal column gets database name. corrupts journal data certain databases. generate_apa_citation uses dplyr::rowwise() — Performance scales poorly large citation sets (O(n) rowwise operations). vectorized. sapply visualization/table filter reactives (app.R:1234-1274, 1605-1648) — Per-row string processing sapply cite_source/cite_label/cite_string slow large datasets. Vectorized tidyverse approach much faster. compare_sources called twice per render — plotHeat plotUpset reactives independently call compare_sources(data_vis, ...).
